description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade8 class within the Opencart install upgrade controller directory. It handles database updates, event renaming, insertion of default events, and table modifications for upgrading the Opencart system to version 8.

classes.name: Upgrade8
classes.description: A controller class responsible for executing database schema and data upgrades specific to version 8 of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that performs the upgrade tasks such as renaming events, adding default events, updating event triggers, modifying database tables, and preparing JSON response with upgrade status.
